slides.title: Losing speed in every short track corner?
slides.sub: Four things, done in order, for a faster bend

slides.title: Get low before the bend
slides.body: Use the last two strides on the straight to set your line, drop to corner height and turn your head through the exit.

slides.title: Lean your whole body in
slides.body: Tip from the ankles and hips so body and blades lean together. If you stay upright, the edges cannot bite and you slide wide.

slides.title: Three parts of every corner
slides.caption: Set the line early, hit maximum lean at the apex, then rise and drive onto the straight.

slides.title: Push with both legs
slides.body: The right leg crosses over and plants, while the left pushes out from underneath. Two power strokes every crossover.

slides.title: Keep the inside hand light
slides.body: The left hand brushes the ice for balance through the apex only. Pressing down scrubs speed and unsettles your line.

slides.text: Most corners are lost before the skater reaches them.
